datagram_transport_parameter: enabled on both native application profiles

executed.client_control: SETUP submitted on a raw unidirectional QUIC stream and client waited for paired server SETUP before opening its request stream
executed.server_control: server accepted a complete client SETUP on the client unidirectional control stream, then opened and sent its paired server control SETUP
executed.client_request: SUBSCRIBE submitted on a raw bidirectional QUIC stream only after paired-control SETUP completed
executed.server_observation: received the paired-control and request-stream payloads after TLS/QUIC handshake
executed.authorization_boundary: server returned REQUEST_ERROR UNAUTHORIZED on the same request stream because no TransportLease/Authority projection was supplied

not_proven: complete draft-21 parameter semantics beyond the narrow SETUP wire validator
object forwarding, relay aggregation, cache semantics, or WebTransport interoperability
interoperability with an independent draft-21 implementation
truth: transport submission is not authorization, subscription, evidence, or external effect
